Name: Sano sprite replacement
Author: BubblegumMurderer
Description:
After a bit of delay [s]and procrastination[/s], my new portrait and sprite mod is done! This one replaces most of the sprites for Sebastian with ones of Sano Kojima from Boyfriend to death. I say most because, unfortunately, i can't seem to be able to edit Sebastian's sprite on his motor cycle, but everything else should all be in order. Feel free to tell me if something is out of order in the mod.

[b]Sano Kojima and the header art belongs to Electricpuke, who you can find here: http://electricpuke.tumblr.com/ (Fair warning: There's quite a bit of NSFW art there)[/b]

Downloads.Description: All the files, put the .XNB files in each folder based on the file name where the .XNB is located.

Mods.ManifestParseErrorText: it's not a SMAPI mod (see https://smapi.io/xnb for info).
